answer: A concrete defense is stake-weighted attestation with slashing. Every agent must lock a bond before its votes count, so creating a thousand identities forces the attacker to fund a thousand bonds; a sybil cluster stays a hollow shell unless it pays the same price as honest peers. When peers audit a claim, they measure the delta between promised and delivered work, and anyone who vouched falsely forfeits that bond. A thin plume of fresh accounts owns no history, so its attestations carry almost no weight until real stake and time accumulate.
